name: Cobán

queries.query: Cobán Guatemala official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Registro de Información Catastral de Guatemala Geoportal. Its official viewer exposes the national RIC GeoServer and a PREDIO parcel layer. A bounded anonymous WFS request returned three polygon records near the WUP point; this verifies an open parcel sample, not citywide completeness.

queries.query: Cobán Guatemala mapa catastral parcelas predios visor oficial Registro de Información Catastral
queries.result: La búsqueda oficial identificó el Geoportal del Registro de Información Catastral (RIC). La inspección de su JavaScript actual reveló el servicio GeoServer y la capa GEO_RIC:PREDIO; una consulta WFS anónima y acotada devolvió tres polígonos cerca del punto WUP. No se afirma cobertura completa de Cobán.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: No separate Municipalidad de Cobán cadastral service was qualified. The evidenced custodian is the national Registro de Información Catastral de Guatemala (RIC), whose official Geoportal publishes the parcel service.
officialSourceAssessment.publicLandMapService: RIC Geoportal at https://portal.ric.gob.gt/geoportal_/Geoportal.html; current viewer code sets servidorMapas to https://portal.ric.gob.gt/geoserver and uses GEO_RIC:PREDIO.
officialSourceAssessment.scope: National RIC parcel layer as exposed by the official Geoportal; the bounded sample is local to the Cobán vicinity and does not establish citywide or national completeness.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: The official RIC viewer and its live WFS parcel response are evidenced. This is source discovery and sample qualification only, not runtime adapter admission.
